subject: NovaWorks onboarding: W-8BEN-E, tax ID evidence, and conditional PO
message_1_subject: Vendor onboarding: initial documents and next steps
message_1_body:
Hi Rishi and Redwood team,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call yesterday. NovaWorks is ready to be set up so we can receive POs and start the September pilot. Can you confirm the exact tax and bank evidence you need for an Italian supplier? We have the following on hand:

- Company registry extract (Registro Imprese)
- Bank reference letter (English)

Attached: (none in this message)

Best,
Marco

message_2_subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: initial documents and next steps
message_2_body:
Hi Marco — thanks for the note and for joining the call. Short version: foreign TIN + a correctly completed W-8BEN-E is typically sufficient for vendor setup, provided the vendor is claiming treaty benefits (if applicable) and the name on the tax form matches the legal entity on the registry extract. Here are the exact items we need to kick off PO creation: 

1) Completed and signed W-8BEN-E (PDF) — please complete Sections I and III/IV as applicable and sign the certification. If you claim a US treaty benefit, state the article and rate.
2) Official company registry excerpt (Registro Imprese) or certificate of incorporation showing legal name and registered address.
3) Bank reference letter (English) or bank account statement showing account holder name and IBAN/SWIFT for payments.
4) Confirm W-8BEN-E legal name matches the name you use for invoicing/payment. If you operate under a DBA, provide evidence linking DBA to legal entity.

A few notes: 
- If the legal name differs (e.g., NovaWorks SRL vs NovaWorks SpA), we will need a formal explanation and documentation tying the two (board resolution, DBA filing, or VAT certificate).
- We don't require a US EIN for non-US payees; foreign TIN is fine for W-8 series forms.
- Once the documents above are validated by Finance, we can issue a conditional PO (PO will be created but payments will be contingent on final bank verification). Typical turnaround is 3-5 business days after we have all items.

Please send the completed W-8BEN-E and attachments as PDFs. If anything will be notarized, flag it in the email.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra

message_3_body:
Rishi — attached please find the signed W-8BEN-E and the bank reference letter (both PDF). We are not claiming a reduced treaty rate; we are asserting non-US status only.

Attachments: NovaWorks_W8BEN-E_signed.pdf; NovaWorks_BankLetter.pdf

Can you confirm if the submitted W-8BEN-E needs to be notarized? Also, any idea when the conditional PO might be generated? We have a planned shipment for the pilot week of Oct 11 and would like the PO in place prior to that.

Marco
message_4_subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: initial documents and next steps
message_4_body:
Hi Marco — thanks for the quick turn. I reviewed the documents you attached. Two items for follow-up before Finance can clear the account:

1) Name consistency: The W-8BEN-E you returned shows "NovaWorks SRL" but our vendor intake portal picked up a different legal name from the company registry (a trailing corporate type mismatch). Could you please forward an official company registry extract (screenshot is OK if it clearly shows the company name and registration number) that matches the W-8 exactly, or provide a short note explaining the difference?

2) Bank verification: the bank letter is acceptable, but we require the account holder name to exactly match the legal entity name on the W-8. If you bank under a parent company, please provide proof of authorization to use that account.

Notarization is not required for W-8BEN-E in most EU cases, but if you prefer to notarize we will accept it — it just slows the timeline. As long as registry + bank letter + completed W-8 line up we can issue a conditional PO.

Thanks — copying Monica from Finance to confirm when a conditional PO can be created once we receive the registry extract.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Vendor Onboarding, Redwood Inference
message_5_subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: initial documents and next steps
message_5_body:

Attachments: NovaWorks_CompanyRegistry.png

We appreciate the note about notarization — we did not notarize this round to avoid delays. Please advise if you still need additional signed authorization for the bank account.

We remain available to provide any corporate attestation or VAT docs you need. If you can issue a conditional PO this week, we will schedule the shipment for Oct 11.

Thanks,
Marco
message_6_subject: PO-55721 issued (conditional) — next steps for payment verification
message_6_body:
Hi Marco — thanks for the registry extract and bank confirmation. Finance has validated the materials we need for a conditional PO. We created PO-55721 in the system (link: https://app.redwood.example.com/po/PO-55721). A few operational notes: 

- PO status: CONDITIONAL — goods/services can be scheduled against the PO but payment is contingent on final bank account verification and remittance instructions.
- Required final items for payment release: a completed vendor W-9/W-8 file recorded in our vendor profile (we have your W-8BEN-E on file), and bank account verification (we use micro-deposit or a bank letter with SWIFT confirmation).
- Timeline: If you confirm bank details by Oct 7, we expect payments to be available after successful micro-deposit verification (1-3 business days).

For now, PO-55721 will be active for ordering; please include the PO number on all invoices and packing lists. Once the bank verification is complete, payments will be scheduled per the PO terms (Net 30 from invoice receipt).

If you would like, we can fast-track payment verification — that requires an additional signed authorization form (I can send it). Let me know which you prefer.

Best regards,
Monica Patel
Senior Accountant, Redwood Inference
